Message:
memory hotplug: small fixes to bootmem freeing for memory hotremove

- Change some naming
  * Magic -> types
  * MIX_INFO -> MIX_SECTION_INFO
  * Change definition of bootmem type from direct hex value

- __free_pages_bootmem() becomes __meminit.
